jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role; it seeks recognised expertise (activists and specialists from the named regions) that the candidate does not have. The Spanish-language convocatoria and regional focus also imply working expertise the candidate lacks, and there is no salaried vacancy here.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with deep, region-specific expertise in environmental defender criminalisation, which the candidate lacks. It also reads as an advisory/voluntary position rather than a genuine paid vacancy, and the deadline has already passed. The human-rights subject is interesting, but the level and nature of the posting are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Media Client Partner
jobs.reason: This is a consultative media-sales role requiring a proven track record of meeting commercial targets, established agency relationships and B2B/advertising sales experience — a sales specialism the candidate lacks entirely and which represents an unmet essential. It is also not entry-level in the research/policy sense and sits outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Procurement Officer
jobs.reason: Not a research or policy role — it is a specialist procurement post whose minimum criteria demand demonstrated experience delivering end-to-end procurement, contract negotiation and private-sector procurement work, none of which the candidate has. It sits entirely outside all three interest zones and offers no meaningful skills overlap, so it barely warrants surfacing despite being technically eligible and London-based.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst, Technology and Geopolitics
jobs.reason: "Lead" title with an explicit essential requirement of experience managing a team places this above entry-level, which is a hard disqualifier given the candidate has no full-time or management experience. Sibylline and tech-geopolitics analysis are squarely in the candidate's zone (b)/(c) interest, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Office Administrator (MSF IE)
jobs.reason: This is a pure administrative / executive-support role centred on office facilities, petty cash and correspondence — not research, policy or analysis, so it draws little on the candidate's core strengths and is a weak paper fit despite being entry-to-junior level. While MSF is a humanitarian organisation, the function sits well outside the candidate's international-law / atrocity-prevention interest zones. Eligible on a technicality but a poor fit on almost every axis.

jobs.title: Commissioning Editor - Collections Management and Acquisition
jobs.reason: The role is broadly entry-level (Bachelor's degree, no heavy experience essential) and the candidate's research and data-analysis skills partly fit, but it is a commercial academic-publishing commissioning role centred on STEM journals and business development, well outside the candidate's policy/IR interest zones. The China location and STEM-preference framing further weaken fit, leaving it a marginal, low-interest option.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor - Multi discipline
jobs.reason: "Lead" title with essential responsibilities including leading large assessment teams, mentoring less experienced Lead Assessors, and maintaining professional registrations — clearly not entry-level and requires established auditor competence the candidate lacks. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and skill set.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.reason: Ineligible on two counts: a "Senior" title requiring substantial product-management experience the candidate lacks, and it demands hands-on digital product ownership and AI-assisted engineering well outside her research/policy profile. The role also sits entirely outside her interest zones.

jobs.title: MSC Chain Of Custody Auditor (Korea)
jobs.reason: Ineligible on experience: the role requires 3–5 years' work experience including food-industry/supply-chain/traceability work plus a recognised Lead Auditor certification the candidate does not hold. It also sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and skill set.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor (Auditeur Principal Senior - Automobile)
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: a "Senior/Lead" role requiring a minimum of 4 years' automotive-industry experience, an engineering degree and IRCA/IATF audit qualifications the candidate lacks, plus French fluency (C-level) beyond the candidate's B1. This is a technical quality-audit role entirely outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Project Support Coordinator
jobs.reason: The role requires "a significant number of years of relevant work experience as a project coordinator" plus practical project-management experience — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, triggering the experience disqualifier. It is also entirely outside all interest zones (nuclear/pressure-equipment conformity assessment).
